_comment: CVE floors. The threshold is NOT hardcoded here for normal freshness — that
comes live from the endoflife.date feed (latest patch of the branch). This
file exists only for the cases a security bulletin pins more precisely than
'latest', and for branches that must be treated as dead regardless of what
A floor stronger than the feed wins; 'eol' is an unreachable value so the
branch can never come back green.
